items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher As Bond Yield Jitters Linger
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Wednesday, Sep, 16 2026 US stock futures are pointing slightly higher in early trade, with E-mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.3% and tech heavy Nasdaq futures ahead roughly 0.4%. The big driver is the US 10 year government bond yield, which briefly touched 5.01% before easing to 4.96%.
